description: This file declares functions for converting Torch JIT Graphs and nodes to ONNX format, including block and node processing, as well as preprocessing and removal of specific operations.

methods.name: ToONNX
methods.description: Converts a Torch JIT Graph to ONNX format, returning a shared pointer to a Graph.

methods.name: BlockToONNX
methods.description: Converts a Block and its contents to ONNX format within the specified environment.

methods.name: NodeToONNX
methods.description: Converts a Node within a Block to ONNX format, updating the environment accordingly.

methods.name: RemovePrintOps
methods.description: Removes print operations from the Graph.

methods.name: PreprocessCaffe2Ops
methods.description: Preprocesses Caffe2-specific operations within the Graph.
